title: Grateful Dead Live at Academy of Music on 1972-03-21

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source with occasional raspiness, yet showcases a fiery Jerry and soaring The Other One > Wharf Rat sequence.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its high energy – Jerry’s guitar is “on fire,” the band pulls off an impressive The Other One into Wharf Rat, and Ramble on Rose shines. Recording quality is mixed: most listeners find it listenable with sweet moments, though a few note raspy spots and brief drop‑outs.

ai_rating.rationale: Five detailed reviews give an average of 4 stars; most comments are positive about performance with only minor recording complaints, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and listenable soundboard capture, but some reviewers mention raspy spots, occasional drop‑outs, and a slightly muffled section that sounds like a harmonica bleed.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Continuous, interesting playing with long intros, a tease of Me & My Uncle, and tight transitions that keep the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "on fire" and very animated on lyrics; guitar tone praised.
band_member_comments.Phil: Provides strong backup vocals on Ramble on Rose; overall solid bass support noted.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith (keys) is mentioned sizing up during Ramble on Rose, hinting at active keyboard presence.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums highlighted in the long intro to The Other One and noted for keeping the groove.
